outcome: Activated partial thromboplastin time (APTT) ordering accuracy
cohort: 20 women who received therapeutic heparin during the peripartum period between June 2014 and June 2016
finding: This study highlights variability in therapeutic heparin protocols utilized during the peripartum period and the desire by clinicians to target a low APTT range during the postnatal peripartum period to balance bleeding risk.
